Member.name: Member
Member.description:
A document store: upload a file, replace it, keep every revision.

The bytes never travel in a batch and never sit in a row. They arrive on the upload route, the command moves them
into the store's own directory, and everything after that names a document by its id and reads its bytes from `url`.

Document.name: Document
Document.description:
A file someone keeps here. `url` is where its bytes are; nothing else carries them.

Who may read it is one expression: anyone on the team, or the holder of a share for this document and no other. A
share is a capability token whose viewer carries `documentId` and nothing else, so that second viewer never existed
as an account and cannot be anything but this. Changing a document is its owner's alone; see the commands.

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: The project it lives in. Everything a person sees is scoped to one.

fields.name: ownerId
fields.description: Who it belongs to: the only person who may replace, rename, share or delete it. `owner` below is the same person, loaded.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Where to read the bytes. Serve them from wherever you keep them; this store serves them itself.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Bumped on every change. Send it back as ifVersion (or If-Match) so a replace cannot lose someone else's.

fields.name: folder
fields.description: Where it is filed, as a path like `contracts/2026`; null is the project's root.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Free words the team puts on it. Filter the list by one.

Note.name: Note
Note.description: A remark on a document, by someone on the team. A share's holder sees none: a link reads the file, not the conversation about it.

Folder.name: Folder
Folder.description: A folder a project's documents are filed in, and how many are in it.

Revision.name: Revision
Revision.description: What the document was before. Every replace keeps one, so nothing is overwritten in place.

Share.name: Share
Share.description: A link to one document, for someone who has no account here.

fields.name: token
fields.description: The capability token. Hand this to whoever the document is for; it carries its own permission.

fields.name: ops
fields.description: What the holder may do. Reading only, for now.

UploadGone.name: UploadGone
UploadGone.description: The upload named by a command was never there, or its lifetime ran out before the command arrived.

UploadTooLarge.name: UploadTooLarge
UploadTooLarge.description: The bytes are over the limit the platform sets for this service. Nothing was kept.

DocumentChanged.name: DocumentChanged
DocumentChanged.description: Raised on every change, with who made it, so another service can say so without asking this one.

DocumentFiled.name: DocumentFiled
DocumentFiled.description: Raised when a document is filed somewhere else. `folder` null is the root.

DocumentNoted.name: DocumentNoted
DocumentNoted.description: Raised when someone remarks on a document, with the start of what they said.

DocumentChanges.name: DocumentChanges
DocumentChanges.description: What updateDocument may change: a field that is absent stays as it is. `folder` null files it at the root.

me.name: me
me.description: Who is asking, as this service knows them. A share's holder is nobody here: a link is not an account.

shared.name: shared
shared.description: The one document a share's token is for. Nobody else has one, so for anyone signed in this is null.

documents.name: documents
documents.description: Everything on a project, newest first. A project's files are the team's, not the uploader's. Each filter narrows.

folders.name: folders
folders.description: The folders a project's documents are filed in, with what each holds. The root is not a folder.

notes.name: notes
notes.description: What the team has said about a document, oldest first. Not for a share: a link reads the file, not the talk about it.

createDocument.name: createDocument
createDocument.description: Take an upload and keep it as a document. The upload is consumed: its bytes move, they are not copied and left.

replaceContent.name: replaceContent
replaceContent.description:
Replace a document's bytes, keeping the old ones as a revision. Send `ifVersion` with the version you read, and a
replace that would land on top of someone else's is refused with `version_conflict` instead.

updateDocument.name: updateDocument
updateDocument.description:
Change a document's name, folder or tags, whichever are sent; the owner's to do, with `ifVersion` (or `If-Match` on
the route). Replaces renameDocument, moveDocument and tagDocument for anything but the events they raise: those
three stay until their sunset, and this one raises DocumentChanged.

args.reason: one command changes every field of a document now

moveDocument.name: moveDocument
moveDocument.description: File a document in a folder, or at the root with null. The owner's to do; send `ifVersion`.

tagDocument.name: tagDocument
tagDocument.description: Put words on a document. Anyone on the team may: tags are the team's, not the owner's. Send `ifVersion`.

addNote.name: addNote
addNote.description: Say something about a document. Everyone on the team reads it; the project's feed says it happened.

shareDocument.name: shareDocument
shareDocument.description:
Hand someone a link to one document. What comes back is a capability token: it speaks for a viewer that can read
this document and nothing else, it may call only the operations it names, and it stops working when it expires.
No account is created, nothing is stored, and it cannot be widened by whoever holds it.

deleteDocument.name: deleteDocument
deleteDocument.description:
Deletes the document, its revisions and their bytes. A share may never, whatever operations its token names: the
token's list is the first gate, and this denial is the second, so widening a token is not enough.
